newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, ARA mogas fairly short.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, ARA mogas fairly short.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday morning, gas oil felled by futures while fuel oil gained $1 a tonne, dealers said.

Gasoline was steady to firm. Eurograde sold at $191 fob AR and $193 fob Rotterdam. Refinery offers held at $193 by late morning. Traders said the market was holding at a level similar to that reached late on Thursday, when one barge traded at $192.

Prompt refinery material was in fairly short supply. Some traders said there were a few shorts in the market who had expected crude to come off, but had been hurried into buying, contributing to gasoline strength.
Heating oil barges dropped almost $2 a tonne as IPE August gas oil futures weakened in what floor traders described as a correction to strong Tuesday gains.
Offers held at IPE August +$1.50 fob Rotterdam for prompt and first half August delivery. There were again few signs of any buyers and no early deals, traders said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $89 fob Rotterdam for stored material and $90 for running refinery product. Offers moved up to $91 fob Rotterdam, but bids backed down from $90 to $89 as crude futures sagged and physical buying tailed off.
Dealers said total ARA demand appeared to be a little above 10,000 tonnes.
-- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
